name: Modern Movement Pack (Experimental)
author: glawks
description: RAC2/3-inspired responsiveness and jump tuning for RAC1: adjustable acceleration, braking, ground/air turning and Heli/Thruster jump tweaks.

settings.name: RAC3-style standing jump
settings.description: Uses RAC3's documented short/held standing-jump targets (1.42 / 2.70 units); does not change running jumps.

settings.name: Match Thruster high jump to Heli-Pack
settings.description: Experimental compensation for the Thruster-Pack's shorter high jump.

settings.name: Thruster high-jump bonus
settings.description: Extra target height for Thruster high jump, on top of the common adjustment. Tune using logs.

settings.name: Both packs: extra high-jump height
settings.description: Optional additional high-jump height for both packs; no measured RAC3 high-jump target yet.

settings.name: Match Heli double jump to Thruster-Pack
settings.description: Experimental early-rise vertical boost based on RAC1 Thruster physics.

settings.name: Both packs: extra double-jump height
settings.description: Optional common double-jump boost; leave at 0 until RAC3 height is measured.

settings.name: Log jump heights
settings.description: Log completed ordinary jump rises only; interrupted jumps and grapples are ignored.

settings.name: Modern movement
settings.description: Enable movement response changes (separate from the jump tuning settings).

settings.name: Faster acceleration
settings.description: Extra fraction of the gap to the game's current run-speed target closed each movement call; 0 is original.

settings.name: Faster braking
settings.description: Extra fraction of the gap when slowing toward the game's target during running; 0 is original. Not the whole stop animation.

settings.name: Faster ground turns
settings.description: Scale running-state turn responsiveness without changing camera movement or top run speed.

settings.name: Faster air turns
settings.description: Adjust the standard standing, running and double-jump air-turn cap. High jumps and long jumps retain their own mechanics.

settings.name: Movement diagnostics
settings.description: Log once when each movement adjustment first activates for troubleshooting.
